daily_logs.summary: Continued device inventory and label work, and helped move the MaintainX label generator from local use to server use.

The new tool used a MaintainX API call to automatically fetch label related data.

actions: Helped with the label generator workflow.

Helped move the tool from a local environment to the server.
Supported making the tool easier for team members to use.
Connected physical asset inventory work with software based label automation.

estimated_time_saving.manual_before: Estimated 2 to 5 minutes per asset label if a person needs to search the asset, copy fields, prepare the label, and print it manually.
estimated_time_saving.automated_after: Estimated 10 to 30 seconds per asset label when the tool can fetch label data through an API call and prepare the label automatically.
estimated_time_saving.estimated_saving_per_label: About 1.5 to 4.5 minutes saved per label.
estimated_time_saving.example_if_50_labels: About 75 to 225 minutes saved, around 1.25 to 3.75 hours.
estimated_time_saving.example_if_100_labels: About 150 to 450 minutes saved, around 2.5 to 7.5 hours.
estimated_time_saving.warning: This is a workflow estimate only. It should be verified later with real label count and real manual timing.

details.result: The label generator became more useful because it was no longer limited to local running. It could support a shared workflow for asset label generation and printing.
details.resume_value: High. This is both development and IT value because it connects API automation, server deployment, and physical asset workflow improvement.

daily_logs.summary: Learned phpIPAM, Docker, and Reconya, then built and deployed an early internal IP mapping tool.

main_work: Studied phpIPAM for IP address management.
Studied Docker for packaging and deployment.
Explored Reconya for network scanning or device discovery.

Used Python for the backend.

Packaged or deployed the tool with Docker on the server.
Explored the idea of AI assisted IP mapping and device name mapping.
details.problem_or_goal: The team needs a clearer way to know which IP addresses are used, which devices they belong to, and how to map IP addresses to real device names or asset records.
actions: Learned how phpIPAM stores or exposes subnet and IP information.
Used Docker to make deployment cleaner and easier to repeat.
Explored Reconya as a scanner to discover devices on the network.
Built a React frontend for the internal tool.
Built a Python backend for data handling and API logic.
Deployed the tool on the internal server through Docker.
Started thinking about how AI could help map unclear IP records to possible device names.
details.result: Created an early deployed internal full stack tool that can support IP address tracking, device mapping, and network inventory visibility.
details.resume_value: Very high. This is the strongest development focused item so far because it includes frontend, backend, Docker deployment, and real internal operations use.
